findings: board_late_init scans NVMe and reads internal ESP partitions before bootcmd
bootflow can initialize USB even with empty preboot
FDT bootcmd overrides environment selected command after preboot
ordinary DWC3 USB startup pulses PHY/core resets; unchanged PMGR does not exclude these effects
usb start shell return zero is insufficient success evidence
atcm1 currently requires active USB; removing initial USB start alone does not provide a valid cold-path comparison
ENV_IS_NOWHERE differs from EFI file variable store
no generic usb4 start command or automatic TB tunnel integration exists in this build
next_test_design: Separate early DWC3 reset and current explicit ATC reset sequence; implement an unprobed-controller entry deliberately before attempting an A/B hardware test
